item.text: {"abilities":[{"advanced_exceptions":[{"citations":[{"quote":"Only one ring may be active at a time.","source_id":"wiki:P"},{"quote":"becomes empowered with Swinging Kama for 4 seconds, during which she cannot create another ring.","source_id":"wiki:P"}],"status":"supported","summary":"Only one ring can exist at once; Akali cannot create another while holding the empowered attack."},{"citations":[{"quote":"The ring will be created around the last target hit by Five Point Strike.","source_id":"wiki:P"}],"status":"supported","summary":"When Q hits multiple targets, the ring forms around the last target hit."},{"citations":[{"quote":"The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against structures and wards.","source_id":"wiki:P"},{"quote":"Does not apply if the triggering attack is dodged, blocked, or misses.","source_id":"wiki:P"}],"status":"supported","summary":"Structures and wards do not consume or receive the empowerment's effects; the bonus damage does not apply when the attack is dodged, blocked, or misses."}],"core_mechanics":[{"citations":[{"quote":"Dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring of energy around them.","source_id":"riot:P"},{"quote":"Akali's damaging abilities against a champion create a ring around them for a few seconds","source_id":"wiki:P"}],"id":"P.ring","summary":"Damaging an enemy champion with an ability creates a ring around them."},{"citations":[{"quote":"Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next Attack with bonus range and damage.","source_id":"riot:P"},{"quote":"empowers her next basic attack with bonus range and magic damage.","source_id":"wiki:P"}],"id":"P.empowered_attack","summary":"Leaving the ring empowers the next basic attack with extra range and bonus magic damage."},{"citations":[{"quote":"she gains move speed while moving away from the ring. Once Akali exits the ring, she regains the move speed towards enemy champions","source_id":"wiki:P"}],"id":"P.movement_speed","summary":"The passive grants movement speed while moving away from the ring, then toward enemy champions after leaving it."}],"slot":"P","unsupported_claims":["Damaging minions or monsters creates a passive ring.","The empowered attack is guaranteed to hit."]},{"advanced_exceptions":[{"citations":[{"quote":"This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.","source_id":"wiki:Q"}],"status":"supported","summary":"The cast originates from Akali's position at the end of its cast time."}],"core_mechanics":[{"citations":[{"quote":"Akali throws out five kunai, dealing damage based on her bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power and slowing.","source_id":"riot:Q"},{"quote":"Akali throws out a cone of kunai that deals magic damage to enemies hit.","source_id":"wiki:Q"}],"id":"Q.cone_damage","summary":"Throws kunai in a cone, dealing magic damage to enemies hit."},{"citations":[{"quote":"Targets hit at maximum range are briefly slowed.","source_id":"wiki:Q"},{"quote":"Targets beyond a certain range are also slowed by 50% for 0.5 seconds.","source_id":"wiki:Q"}],"id":"Q.outer_slow","summary":"Enemies hit in the outer portion of the cone are briefly slowed."}],"slot":"Q","unsupported_claims":["Every enemy hit by Q is slowed regardless of distance.","Each kunai separately damages the same enemy."]},{"advanced_exceptions":[{"citations":[{"quote":"Entering the shroud renders Akali invisible, unless she is dashing.","source_id":"wiki:W"},{"quote":"Akali will also not gain the invisibility if she is Recalling.","source_id":"wiki:W"}],"status":"supported","summary":"Dashing and recalling prevent gaining shroud invisibility."},{"citations":[{"quote":"Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.","source_id":"wiki:W"}],"status":"supported","summary":"An attack reveals Akali when its windup begins."},{"citations":[{"quote":"The shroud does not permeate terrain, and will expand toward nearby enemy champions.","source_id":"wiki:W"},{"quote":"The marked section of Twilight Shroud will linger for the mark's duration, even after the shroud ends.","source_id":"wiki:W"}],"status":"supported","summary":"The shroud cannot spread through terrain; a section marked by E persists for the mark's duration even if the shroud ends."}],"core_mechanics":[{"citations":[{"quote":"While inside the shroud, Akali becomes invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks.","source_id":"riot:W"},{"quote":"She also drops a smoke shroud that makes her invisible","source_id":"wiki:W"}],"id":"W.shroud_protection","summary":"Creates a smoke shroud that grants invisibility inside it, preventing enemies from selecting Akali with attacks and spells while she is invisible."},{"citations":[{"quote":"Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.","source_id":"riot:W"},{"quote":"Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the invisibility","source_id":"wiki:W"}],"id":"W.action_reveal","summary":"Attacking or casting an ability briefly breaks shroud invisibility."},{"citations":[{"quote":"Akali drops a cover of smoke and briefly gains Move Speed.","source_id":"riot:W"},{"quote":"Akali restores energy and gains a brief burst of move speed.","source_id":"wiki:W"}],"id":"W.movement_speed","summary":"Casting W grants a brief burst of movement speed."},{"citations":[{"quote":"Akali restores energy","source_id":"wiki:W"},{"quote":"While the shroud is active, Akali's maximum energy is increased by 100.","source_id":"wiki:W"}],"id":"W.energy","summary":"Restores energy and temporarily increases maximum energy while the shroud is active."}],"slot":"W","unsupported_claims":["Shroud makes Akali immune to damage.","Shroud prevents all area damage or cancels attacks and spells already in flight.","Shroud always hides Akali from every source of detection."]},{"advanced_exceptions":[{"citations":[{"quote":"Akali will not flip backwards if she is immobilized or grounded in the first 0.15 seconds of the cast time.","source_id":"wiki:E"}],"status":"supported","summary":"Early immobilization or grounding can prevent the backward flip."},{"citations":[{"quote":"She will not stop tracking the target until she reaches them, as there is no maximum tracking distance.","source_id":"wiki:E"},{"quote":"Shuriken Flip cannot be recast if the target is untargetable or is in another realm.","source_id":"wiki:E"}],"status":"supported","summary":"The recast tracks moving targets without a maximum tracking distance, but cannot be initiated against an untargetable target or one in another realm."},{"citations":[{"quote":"Attempting to cast Five Point Strike during either dash will buffer it to cast as soon as the dash ends.","source_id":"wiki:E"}],"status":"supported","summary":"Q attempted during either E dash is buffered until that dash ends."}],"core_mechanics":[{"citations":[{"quote":"Flip backward and fire a shuriken forward, dealing magic damage.","source_id":"riot:E"},{"quote":"Akali dashes backward and throws a shuriken forward that deals magic damage","source_id":"wiki:E"}],"id":"E.flip_projectile","summary":"Flips backward while throwing a damaging shuriken forward."},{"citations":[{"quote":"The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked.","source_id":"riot:E"},{"quote":"The shuriken marks and reveals the enemy or the last Twilight Shroud smoke section hit for 3 seconds","source_id":"wiki:E"}],"id":"E.mark","summary":"The shuriken can mark the first enemy hit or a section of Twilight Shroud, enabling a recast."},{"citations":[{"quote":"Re-cast to dash to the marked target, dealing additional damage.","source_id":"riot:E"},{"quote":"Akali dashes towards the marked target or smoke section. Against enemies she deals magic damage upon arrival.","source_id":"wiki:E"}],"id":"E.return_dash","summary":"Recasting dashes to the marked enemy or smoke section, dealing additional magic damage upon arrival against an enemy."}],"slot":"E","unsupported_claims":["The return dash damages enemies along its entire path.","The return dash can be initiated against any marked target regardless of targetability or realm."]},{"advanced_exceptions":[{"citations":[{"quote":"dealing physical damage to enemies she passes through.","source_id":"wiki:R"},{"quote":"Akali dashes 750 units in the direction of the target enemy champion, dealing magic damage to enemies she passes through.","source_id":"wiki:R"}],"status":"disputed","summary":"The Wiki's introductory and detailed descriptions disagree about the first dash's damage type. Retain its damaging dash core without requiring a damage type."},{"citations":[{"quote":"Perfect Execution can be recast after a 2.5-second static cooldown within 10 seconds of the first activation.","source_id":"wiki:R"}],"status":"supported","summary":"The second dash has a brief lockout and a limited recast window."},{"citations":[{"quote":"Enemies already hit by either of Perfect Execution's casts cannot be affected more than once by the same cast.","source_id":"wiki:R"},{"quote":"Casting Flash during either dashes will interrupt them, but Akali will deal damage to any enemies she comes in contact with at the new location.","source_id":"wiki:R"}],"status":"supported","summary":"Each cast hits a given enemy only once; Flash interrupts either dash but can apply its damage at the new location."}],"core_mechanics":[{"citations":[{"quote":"Akali leaps in a direction, damaging enemies she strikes.","source_id":"riot:R"},{"quote":"Akali dashes in the direction of the target enemy champion","source_id":"wiki:R"},{"quote":"dealing magic damage to enemies she passes through.","source_id":"wiki:R"}],"id":"R.initial_dash","summary":"The first cast targets an enemy champion and dashes in their direction, damaging enemies along the path."},{"citations":[{"quote":"Re-cast: Akali dashes in a direction, executing all enemies she strikes.","source_id":"riot:R"},{"quote":"Recast: Akali dashes in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies she passes through based on their missing health.","source_id":"wiki:R"}],"id":"R.recast_execute_damage","summary":"The recast dashes in a chosen direction, dealing magic damage along its path that increases with enemies' missing health."}],"slot":"R","unsupported_claims":["The first cast can freely target a direction without an enemy champion.","The recast automatically kills every enemy it hits or bypasses protection.","Either cast stuns enemies."]}]}
